info.title: General Translation API
info.description:
Translate content and manage projects with the General Translation API at `https://api.gtx.dev`.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`. Each endpoint lists its required permissions. Project keys (`gtx-api-`) access one project; Organization keys (`gtx-org-`) access projects in one Organization.

For project-scoped requests, use the project ID in the path. If you also send `gt-project-id`, it must match. Without a project ID in the path, project keys use their own project; Organization keys require `gt-project-id`. Discovery endpoints need no project ID. Organization-scoped requests use the Organization ID in the path. You must have access to the selected project or Organization.

In batches and imports, items match stored items by natural key, stored items absent from the batch are untouched, and nothing else is deleted. A blank CSV cell counts as absent.
